crossRefs.keyword: cast dust. Heb. dusted him with dust

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Benjamite who cursed David during Absalom's rebellion.

translations.web: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hillside opposite him, and cursed as he went, threw stones at him, and threw dust.
translations.bsb: So David and his men proceeded along the road as Shimei went along the ridge of the hill opposite him. As Shimei went, he yelled curses, threw stones, and flung dust at David.
translations.kjv: And as David and his men went by the way, Shimei went along on the hill's side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
translations.asv: So David and his men went by the way; and Shimei went along on the hill-side over against him, and cursed as he went, and threw stones at him, and cast dust.
